title: Pine Labs Helpdesk — BIN Series API Contract

authentication.currentStatus: Authentication boundary implemented; production identity-provider validation remains pending Pine Labs SSO/OIDC configuration. Every request is currently rejected with 401 AUTH_PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED regardless of the token supplied, until a real provider is wired up.
authentication.actorHandling: There is no client-suppliable actor/user field anywhere in these APIs. The acting user for audit logging and updatedBy is always derived server-side from the authenticated caller.

errorFormat.description: Every error response (any non-2xx) uses this envelope.

commonErrorCodes.meaning: Real identity provider not yet configured (current state for every token).
Request shape/format failed schema validation (bad field type, pattern, required field missing/blank).
No BIN record exists for the given id / (binIin, merchantPrefix) pair.
A BIN record already exists with this exact (binIin, merchantPrefix).
merchantId was supplied but does not reference an existing merchant.
On update: instanceName was explicitly sent as null, or the update would leave the record without one.

BinRecordResponse.description: Returned by list, resolve, create, and update.

merchantId.note: Soft link to the merchants table (SOP/classification domain). Not a business-name field.

instanceName.note: Null for legacy records created before this field existed (all 611 originally seeded records).

updatedBy.note: Name of the user who last created/updated this record via the write APIs. Null if never touched by them (e.g. seeded data).

merchantId.rule: if supplied, must reference an existing merchant

instanceName.rule: must not be missing, null, empty, or whitespace-only; trimmed server-side

UpdateBinRecordRequest.description: Partial update — every field optional. Omitting a field leaves it unchanged.

merchantId.rule: if present, must reference an existing merchant

instanceName.rule: omit = leave unchanged; explicit null is REJECTED (422 BIN_INSTANCE_NAME_REQUIRED); empty/whitespace REJECTED (422 VALIDATION_ERROR); if this update changes ANY field and the record has no instanceName yet, one must be supplied in this same request

search.description: Substring match across issuer, cardProgramGroupName, binIin, merchantPrefix

endpoints.name: Resolve one BIN record
endpoints.description: Exact (binIin, merchantPrefix) lookup only. Never returns a partial match.

errorResponses.when: no record matches the exact pair

endpoints.name: Create BIN record

errorResponses.when: missing/blank issuer, cardProgramGroupName, or instanceName; malformed binIin/merchantPrefix
merchantId supplied but does not exist

endpoints.audit: Creates a revision: action=create, entityType=bin_record. Actor is always the authenticated caller, never client-supplied.

endpoints.name: Update BIN record

requestBody.description: Partial update — send only the fields you want to change.

errorResponses.when: malformed binIin/merchantPrefix, or instanceName sent as empty/whitespace
merchantId supplied but does not exist
instanceName sent as explicit null, OR this update changes something while the record still has no instanceName
changing binIin/merchantPrefix would collide with another record

notes: A request that changes nothing (resends identical values) is a no-op: 200 OK, no audit revision created, updatedBy/updatedAt untouched.
instanceName can be omitted if the record already has one and you're only changing other fields.
instanceName cannot be omitted if the record currently has none AND you are changing any other field in this same request — must be supplied together.
endpoints.audit: Creates a revision only if something actually changed: action=update, entityType=bin_record, change description lists every changed field (e.g. 'Issuer changed from X to Y; instance name changed from A to B'). Actor is always the authenticated caller.

endpoints.name: Delete BIN record
endpoints.audit: Creates a revision: action=delete, entityType=bin_record, entityId=the deleted record's former id (soft reference, not a FK — survives the record's deletion). Actor is always the authenticated caller.

notImplemented.description: Explicitly out of scope so far — do not assume these exist.
items: SOP write APIs of any kind (SOP is currently read-only: GET sheet detail, GET sheet rows, GET common escalation)

openQuestionsForProduct: Should 'issuer' be renamed to 'issuerName'? No field called 'merchantName' was found in the BIN domain to rename — 'issuer' already serves that role and matches the frontend's own field name.
Confirm the instanceName-mandatory-on-update interpretation: a real write must leave the record with a non-blank instanceName, but omitting it is fine if the record already has one.
What should instanceName actually reference long-term (currently a free-text string, no backend 'instances' table exists)?
